probe.text_sample: Old Tom Capital | Golf's Institutional Platform Firm Platform Portfolio Insights InVEST WITH US Contact Firm Platform Portfolio Insights Invest with us Contact Golf's Institutional Platform Golf's Institutional Platform A specialist firm consolidating the business of the game. Explore the Platform INVEST with us The Opportunity in Plain Sight Golf has never been stronger or more under-institutionalized. Participation is growing faster than ownership, infrastructure, and capital can adapt. Thousands of family-run courses, media platforms, and service operators remain fragmented, constrained by succession risk, limited technology, and undercapitalization. Old Tom Capital was built for this moment. We consolidate proven assets, professionalize core systems, and own the next phase of value creation. vibe.evidence: The use of a large, high-contrast photograph, sans-serif typography, and a clean, structured layout suggests an editorial style. The limited color palette and the subtle geometric lines contribute to a calm and confident mood. The overall design feels professional and well-organized, with ample whitespace.
